description: Fixed school-level average class sizes and test scores for simple OLS and uncertainty comparisons.
source: Original synthetic OpenEconometrics teaching data; not real observations.

columns.name: school_id
columns.description: School identifier from 1 to 240; a label, not a predictor.

columns.name: class_size
columns.description: Average students per class; fractional averages are valid.

columns.name: test_score
columns.description: Average test score on an artificial teaching scale.
